reports.category: Report Miscellaneous Crypto Scams with Chainabuse: Overpayment scam
reports.description:
The scammer contacted me as a buyer of some used furniture I have advertised on Facebook Marketplace. He insisted to pay via wire transfer and promised to arrange a courier to pick up the furniture. He stated he was Croatian and also sent an ID as proof. But the photo on the ID was matching someone else with the same name on Facebook. The phone number he was contacting me using Viber and WhatsApp was Nigerian. After agreeing on the details he sent me the following message: 
_x000D_
*** Start of message ***_x000D_
Hello! I have now completed the transfer of the full amount, including the charges requested by PayPal, and have received confirmation from PayPal.  I have added 100 euro for the shipping fee and  that should be sent via Bitcoin ATM to the shipping companys headquarters or simply by phone or computer via a link (http://buy.moonpay.io) with your card, then send a scanned copy of your Bitcoin purchase information to PayPal for verification ..._x000D_
_x000D_
  Here is the senders Bitcoin wallet to which you must transfer the shipping fee_x000D_
_x000D_
_x000D_
  Bitcoin wallet: 3FMfjjSVkxUPCp611Fs6w9kY294tdeeBsW_x000D_
_x000D_
_x000D_
 I advise you to check your inbox or spam folder to see the PayPal confirmation email in one of these folders. The courier will contact you to arrange a pre-arrival time_x000D_
_x000D_
 Its good to do business with you_x000D_
_x000D_
 I look forward to your early reply_x000D_
*** End of message ***_x000D_
_x000D_
Of course he has not transferred any money to my PayPal account and I did not pay for the scammer either, so theres no financial damage on my side. Im reporting the case to warn / inform others.
